cacert.built_from: curl.se Mozilla CA bundle (Mozilla's certdata as of 2026-11-05); sha256 matches https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem.sha256. The file ships in this tree as pts-core/static/update/cacert.pem; the installer checks it against this pin and points PHP at it (php.ini curl.cainfo and openssl.cafile)
